regions.name: MeshCore community presets (app list)
regions.note: Every preset is a community default for its area, so every non-deprecated one is tier 0. Firmware build default (no app) = 869.618 / 62.5 / SF8 / CR5 (platformio.ini); the app's EU/UK preset is CR8 — the header carries CR, so both decode.

countryLanding.note: Ordered block ids: the first is the landing block. Built from the region tables here (Meshtastic region labels, MeshCore preset titles, TTN frequency-plans.yml country-codes, RP002 Table 1 spot checks). Countries not listed fall back by ITU region of the server's position (lon < -25 and > -170 = R2; else R3 if lon > 60 and lat < 55 or south-east Asia/Oceania; else R1).
